title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Iowa on 1982-08-10
source: Matrix using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC)

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch matrix recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with blistering Bertha, a legendary China → Rider jam, and soaring vocals.
ai_review.review: The Hunter‑mixed matrix source delivers an enveloping, crystal‑clear sound that lets the band’s intensity shine. Highlights include a record‑fast Bertha, one of the best China → Rider sequences ever, plus standout performances of Roses, Sailor → Saint, Eyes That Follow and Stella Blue. Though the show starts a bit loose and has a few technical quirks, the overall energy is sky‑high.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the musical performance (high energy, many standout jams) and the matrix recording quality; only one very negative review offsets the average but does not dominate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hunter’s matrix mix is enveloping with superb clarity; a brief voice‑panning glitch for Jerry early on and minor drop‑outs are noted, but overall the sound is crisp, balanced and highly listenable.

poor_songs: Iko Iko (slow compared to surrounding material)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A wildly varied setlist that starts a bit sloppy but quickly gains momentum, delivering powerful second‑set jams and tight transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Expressive, fast playing (notably on Bertha) and emotional solos; brief voice‑panning issue early in the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Thumping, gritty bass that drives the band—called his 'finest hour' by reviewers.
